source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Predict how the apparent distance of a plane-mirror image changes when the object moves closer to or farther from the mirror.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: The image moves farther from the mirror when the object moves closer.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: For every mirror shape, moving the object closer always makes its image closer to the mirror.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The image stays on the mirror surface, so its distance from the mirror remains zero.

intelligence.enrichment: When an object is close to a plane mirror, its image also appears close to the mirror; when the object is far from the mirror, its image appears far from the mirror. Changing the object's distance from the plane mirror changes the apparent distance of its image in the same near-or-far direction. The learner correctly applies this rule: When an object is close to a plane mirror, its image also appears close to the mirror; when the object is far from the mirror, its image appears far from the mirror. A plane mirror keeps every image at one fixed distance behind it.
